errors.text: The proposed L21 Heusler precipitate replaces the target C14 Laves secondary phase without evidence that a coherent, magnetic L21 phase can be stabilized in the specified Fe-Co-Ni-Ti matrix.

The central assertion that L21 ordering restores or enhances orbital moment is not supported by the cited evidence, which concerns phase stability, mechanical response, lattice misfit, or B2/BCC decomposition rather than orbital magnetism in Fe-Co-Ni-Ti.
The proposed mechanism omits the target antiferromagnetic coupling between Ti and the Fe/Co/Ni sublattice, spin-canted contributions, and the phase-specific magnetic transitions.

The experiment distinguishes a hypothetical fcc/L21 material from single-phase fcc but cannot reconstruct the target attribution of the 1084 K and 168 K transitions to fcc and the lower-temperature transition to C14.
